scope: Deterministic standalone NL0 software and numerical contracts only

implemented.plastic_experts: Declared 16-expert width-256/hidden-1024 shape reference with tiny fixture widths; selected-expert-only updates, no inactive gradients or optimizer state
implemented.optimizer: NativeFusedAdamW production interface plus differentiable exact AdamW reference, bias correction, nonzero decoupled weight decay, one/two/four-step reference horizons and first-order identity-adaptation distinction
implemented.gradient_control: Per-step global selected-expert norm clipping before AdamW, including a later-step activation regression
implemented.recurrence: Bounded normalized associative transition/read/loss with direct and later-read finite-difference gradient checks
implemented.transaction: Exactly-once event identity, changed-identity rejection, atomic candidate publication and rollback across weights, moments, counters, clock, dedup and revision
implemented.observation: One shared pre-chunk read, canonical event-order reduction, at-most-one transition per sealed chunk, zero transitions for empty/ineligible chunks, reader-count independence
implemented.causality: Scope/cutoff validation, fail-closed backdated views/seals, cutoff-bound FrozenView IDs, visible-write revision advance and cache invalidation
implemented.persistence: Atomic checkpoint save/load, complete live-state rollback on late failure, FP32-only finite plastic and observation weights, post-copy finiteness, content-derived transition/revision accounting, dedup and retry restoration
implemented.identity_and_controls: Stable frozen personality identity inherited consistently, revision cache invalidation, fixed and shuffled mechanical route controls, optional observer/spine absence parity

verification.failure_note: The first XML records the expected old-status assertion failure after qualification status changed to software_math_qualified; the assertion was updated and the final suite passed. It is not a numerical or state-contract failure.
